notes: Three taḥwīl branches meet at سفيان; the names written once after the last ح (علقمة، سليمان، أبيه) form the shared tail.
The last group is a variant: a different man (Muqatil, Muslim b. Haysam, al-Nu'man) for the same saying, so it is not a route of this saying.
The variant group should not take the shared tail; the tool should treat it separately. Gloss-type items (واللفظ له، يعني ابن مهدي، المعنى) are left out.
